tieu_de: Middle/Senior DevOps Engineer Python, Linux, English
mo_ta_cong_viec:
ITviec's client is seeking an exceptionally talented Middle/Senior DevOps Engineer who will work closely with Software Engineers to help them deploy and operate different systems. In addition, this position will join a group responsible for various core platforms within the enterprise.
Work within the team on the various products that the team supports
Develop tools to improve our ability to rapidly deploy and effectively monitor services in a large-scale distributed environment
Work with teams to design, develop, and implement innovative software solutions related to the DevOps and Agile transformation of the enterprise.
Participate in periodic on-call duties
Collaborate with peers both inside and outside your team.
yeu_cau:
3+ years of experience as a DevOps Engineer with excellent communication skills and a positive, “can-do” attitude.
Proficient in Python development with hands-on experience.
Solid understanding of the Linux environment, particularly with command-line usage.
Experienced in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) frameworks such as Ansible, Terraform, and Helm charts.
Familiar with Docker and Kubernetes.
Experience with Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) using GitLab (preferred), GitHub, or Git.
Familiar with JIRA and Wiki tools.
Effective English communication abilities.
Agile development experience is a plus
quyen_loi:
Work Environment & Culture:
Engage with a youthful, dynamic team working on awesome projects applying cutting-edge technologies.
Gain global exposure by working alongside international specialists, providing a fantastic opportunity to expand your skill set.
A transparent, honest, and respectful culture that empowers individuals to reach their full potential.
Compensation & Health Benefits:
13th-month salary and highly attractive performance-based bonuses.
Premium accident and healthcare insurance plans, plus comprehensive annual health check-ups.
Allowances & Facilities:
Allowances for lunch, free parking, and life events (marriage, newborn baby, bereavement, etc.).
A spacious, fully equipped pantry (microwave, fridge, coffee maker, etc.) for your most comfortable lunch breaks.
Engagement & Recognition:
Diverse sports clubs and social activities (Badminton, Football, Yoga, Tech clubs).
Annual company teambuilding trips.
Engaging monthly internal events: Happy Gatherings, Mini Games, Team Birthdays, Year-End Party, etc.
Quarterly and yearly awards recognizing outstanding individuals, teams, and long-term dedication.
Advanced English and soft skill training programs to assist your career development.
Exclusive perk: Unique internal company supporting funds to help ease personal financial goals (Home, Vehicle, Tuition loans, etc.).
